notes: Native GTK4 AGPC View 0.1.0-4 for amd64, built and GUI-checked by canonical main CI. Local is restricted to this computer’s information and existing Manager prechecks; all network observations belong to Mesh. The read-only Mesh mode requires Account browser SSO at account.ypcloud.com. Teal Local and violet Mesh styles follow light, dark and high-contrast themes. Native checks cover the authentication gate; successful human sign-in remains separate live evidence. Requires AGPC Mesh >=3.0.0-3 and <4, GTK4 >=4.8 and glibc >=2.39. Run agpc-view as the desktop user. This standalone release does not change Core/All installers, enable Mesh RUN, or establish runtime readiness. Verify MANIFEST.json.asc and SHA256SUMS.asc with the established MoteBus archive key before installing.
